blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Residents are urged to take immediate precautions as the city faces dangerous heat, with the heat index forecast to spike to 39°C by Saturday, Oct. 17. In a Thursday advisory, the City Information Office released a two-day forecast placing today’s heat index at 37°C and tomorrow’s at 39°C. Both days are categorized under “Extreme Caution.” At these temperatures, health authorities warn that heat cramps and heat exhaustion may occur, while continued activity in the heat could lead to heat stroke.
